selection_design.cluster_recovery: weighted Hungarian-overlap matching to each regional reference; descriptive Jaccard, no new threshold
selection_design.elbow_rule: smallest eligible nonmatched k within 95% of maximum normalized chord-minus-inertia gap
selection_design.primary_stability: existing median and lower-decile pairwise ARI >=0.80 in both tests
selection_design.search_status: exploratory development selection after observing matched-resolution results; not independent confirmation
